import polars as pl

df = pl.DataFrame({
    "date": ["2024-01-01", "2024-01-01", "2024-01-02", "2024-01-02"],
    "city": ["NYC", "LA", "NYC", "LA"],
    "temperature": [32.5, 68.0, 30.1, 70.2],
})

wide = df.pivot(
    on="city",
    index="date",

)
